items.title: Malik Nabers: Out of non-contact jersey
items.description:
Nabers (knee) wasn't wearing a non-contact red jersey at Monday's practice, Perry Sook of WPIX reports.

items.title: Kayshon Boutte: Dealt to Texans
items.description:
The Patriots traded Boutte to the Texans for safety Jaylen Reed and a draft pick Monday, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

items.title: Kenyon Sadiq: Aiming to be available Week 1
items.description:
Coach Aaron Gleen said Monday that the Jets are targeting Week 1 for Sadiq (hernia) to return to action, Zack Rosenblatt of The Athletic reports.

items.title: Jacory Croskey-Merritt: Slated to work on side field this week
items.description:
Coach Dan Quinn said Monday that Croskey-Merritt (lower body) will work on the side with the Commanders' training staff this week, John Keim of ESPN.com reports.

items.title: Rachaad White: Back in individual drills Monday
items.description:
